title.zh: 陆奇创办的奇绩创坛遭美国制裁：前Google工程师窃密案牵连4家实体
title.en: 陆奇创办的奇绩创坛遭美国制裁：前Google工程师窃密案牵连4家实体

current_state.zh: The US Treasury sanctioned Qi Lu's MiraclePlus accelerator and four related Chinese entities, including Shanghai Zhisuan Technology, for providing seed funding and equity to a former Google engineer convicted of stealing TPU/GPU and AI supercomputing trade secrets, freezing US-jurisdictional assets and barring US persons from certain investments with a wind-down period through January 2027.
current_state.en: The US Treasury sanctioned Qi Lu's MiraclePlus accelerator and four related Chinese entities, including Shanghai Zhisuan Technology, for providing seed funding and equity to a former Google engineer convicted of stealing TPU/GPU and AI supercomputing trade secrets, freezing US-jurisdictional assets and barring US persons from certain investments with a wind-down period through January 2027.
